uhc.text: For an emergency room visit, level 3 (moderate), UnitedHealthcare commercial plans show hospital prices ranging from $1,486 to $1,918. The median price is $1,811, and most prices fall between $1,706 and $1,811.

bcbs_az.text: An emergency room visit, level 3 (moderate), is billed to Blue Cross Blue Shield of Arizona commercial plans. The lowest price is $253 at 2 Dignity Health (CommonSpirit) hospitals, the highest is $963 at Phoenix Children's Hospital, and the highest price is 3.8 times the lowest.

aetna.text: An emergency room visit, level 3 (moderate) for Aetna commercial (employer or individual) plans had a lowest price of $1,310 at Banner Casa Grande Medical Center and a highest price of $1,886 at 2 Dignity Health (CommonSpirit) hospitals. The full price range was $1,310 to $1,886, while most prices fell between $1,678 and $1,824. The median price was $1,678.

cigna.text: For Cigna commercial (employer or individual) plans, an emergency room visit, level 3 (moderate), has a lowest price of $1,032 at St Josephs Hospital And Medical Center and a highest price of $1,833 at 2 Dignity Health (CommonSpirit) hospitals. humana.text: Emergency room visit, level 3 (moderate) for Humana commercial (employer or individual) plans has lowest price $234 and highest price $238 across 8 hospitals in 2 health systems. The median price is $234, and most prices fall between $234 and $238.

cash.text: An emergency room visit, level 3 (moderate) costs $299 at the lowest and $3,024 at the highest for cash patients. The highest price is 10.1 times the lowest, and most prices fall between $366 and $2,304. Data from 28 hospitals across 7 health systems show cash prices below typical insured rates in 71% of comparisons.
